title: ANALISTA DE SUPORTE E TECNOLOGIA PL
description: Estamos buscando um Analista de Suporte e Tecnologia Pleno que será responsável em atuar de forma proativa e integrada na gestão da infraestrutura física de TI, garantindo disponibilidade, resiliência e evolução dos ambientes de missão crítica, por meio do acompanhamento técnico, da análise de projetos, da gestão de capacidade, do cumprimento de SLAs e da melhoria contínua dos processos e serviços prestados. Atuar na análise de projetos com objetivo de garantir maior assertividade na entrega através de ativdades de Pré-Site, reduzindo prazos e otimização da infraestrutura. Domínio no suporte aos elementos de infraestrutura elétrica em média e baixa tensão passando por elementos de sustentação da continuidade e geração da energia para os ambientes de Missão Crítica de TI. Domínio no suporte a infraestrutura de refrigeração com elementos específicos que garantam a continuidade das operações para as áreas técnicas TI que sustentam todas as aplicações de TI da empresa. Necessário conhecimento das demais disciplinas de infraestrutura física, como, Sistemas de Detecção precoce e convencional de incêndio, Sistemas de combate a incêndio, Sistemas de controle de acesso físico, cabeamento lógico estruturado, iluminação, asseio, Sistemas de CFTV, Sistemas de monitoração ambiental e infraestrura civil. title: ELECTRICAL ENGINEER
description: GA Drilling is developing next-generation drilling technologies to unlock geothermal energy anywhere on Earth. Our mission is to make geothermal a globally scalable, baseload source of clean power by enabling access to hard, hot rock at depths and temperatures that conventional drilling cannot reach economically. Our work demands mastery across electronics, hydraulics, mechanics, systems, control, and project management to create products that survive and perform in harsh, high-temperature, high-load downhole conditions. We are seeking an engineer with 5+ years' experience in power-electronics design, testing, and manufacturing, as well as prototyping, operating, and debugging the associated test equipment. The ideal candidate will be equally well versed in design, analysis, and test. You will be based at our Brazil office in Rio de Janeiro. The opportunity for you You will own the development of power-electronic hardware, analog and digital circuits, and embedded high-voltage systems for our downhole drilling technologies. The role spans schematic design, prototype bring-up, validation testing, and field support — working closely with mechanical, firmware, and systems engineers, and providing direct technical support to operations and drilling crews during testing and deployments. Responsibilities Design & Development Develop power electronic hardware, analog and digital circuits, and embedded high-voltage systems and control applications. Create system block diagrams, schematics, wiring harnesses, and detailed electrical designs using engineering CAD software. Design and implement electrical stress tests (e.g., pressure, temperature, vibration) to ensure product reliability and durability. Look ahead at validation requirements, and develop and execute test plans and setups using both firmware and hardware debugging tools. Testing, Validation & Field Support Conduct prototype board bring-up, functional testing, and performance analysis. Troubleshoot electronic faults at the component and system level using diagnostic tools such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, and spectrum analyzers. Provide technical support to field service technicians and on-site drilling crews to resolve operational problems. Collaborate across mechanical, firmware, systems, and project teams on product development, testing, and failure analysis. Support a positive and proactive HSE culture and ensure that all activities adhere to HSE policy. What we expect from you Experience & Technical Domain Knowledge 5+ years of power electronics engineering experience, ideally within advanced engineering for complex industrial product development environments. Experience with high-voltage transmission and protection, and motor control electronic circuits (motor drivers, position feedback) used in oil & gas drilling, electric actuators, automation systems, electric vehicles, and similar applications. Experience with DC-DC converters (Buck/Boost, Flyback) used in power supplies across industrial and consumer electronics, including permanent downhole installations for oil & gas. Experience with analog and digital filters used across transmission networks, radio, satellite, medical devices, and oil & gas sensors and signal monitoring. Experience with sensors found in industrial and commercial electronics, including permanent downhole installations for oil & gas. Proficiency with electronics simulation and CAD tools used to model, simulate, and design electronic devices. Ability to work in both Portuguese and English. Strong analytical thinking and ability to read technical documentation, schematics, and engineering specifications. Customer Interface & Cross-Functional Collaboration Experience working directly with operations teams, field service technicians, and on-site drilling crews to support testing, deployments, and resolution of operational problems. Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate field and test observations into clear, actionable engineering feedback. Execution, Testing & Operational Excellence Strong attention to detail with a disciplined approach to testing, documentation, and configuration control. Demonstrated ability to work independently, execute project plans from high-level direction, and deliver reliably against schedule and milestones. Experience contributing to root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement driven by test and field results. Ability to balance speed and rigor in fast-moving, technically challenging environments. Professional Mindset & Working Style Hands-on, practical mindset with a strong bias toward action and problem solving. Comfortable working in the lab, on the shop floor, in test environments, and in the field as required, including occasional travel. Strong safety and quality focus, with respect for procedures while helping evolve them as systems mature. Adaptable, resilient, and effective in early-stage and transitioning-to-commercial technology environments. Ability to provide and receive constructive, technically grounded feedback that improves product performance and reliability. Nice to have BSEE or MSEE preferred. Experience with embedded firmware development for high-voltage or motor control applications. Exposure to oil & gas, drilling, or downhole electronics qualification standards. Interest in geothermal energy, drilling systems, or high-temperature downhole environments. What we offer: Opportunity to develop unique and innovative technological solutions which have the potential to change the world. The satisfaction of solving challenges associated with making ultra-deep geothermal energy a commercial reality. Be part of an experienced, global and highly motivated team. Collaborate with the world’s top industry players. Competitive industry compensation & benefits. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Training & Readiness Manager

What we expect from you Experience & Technical Domain Knowledge 3+ years of experience working with mechanical and hydraulic equipment, preferably in an industrial or oilfield environment. Technical school certificate in mechanical technology, mechatronics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. Proficiency with mechanical and hydraulic test equipment (pressure and temperature rigs, torque tools, hydraulic benches), dimensional metrology instruments (calipers, micrometers, dial indicators), and hand and power tools. Skilled in mechanical assembly and disassembly, including torque‑controlled fastening, seal and o‑ring installation, and alignment of rotating and reciprocating components. Ability to read, understand, and interpret technical manuals, drawings, schematics, blueprints, and engineering instructions. Experience troubleshooting and repairing mechanical and hydraulic equipment and generating clear service and calibration reports. Ability to work in both Portuguese and English. Basic computer literacy and familiarity with data acquisition and diagnostic software, plus strong problem‑solving, analytical, and critical thinking skills. Customer Interface & Cross‑Functional Collaboration Experience working alongside engineers, field representatives, and drilling crews to support testing, deployments, and on‑site troubleshooting. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to capture lab and field test observations as clear, actionable feedback for engineering. Execution, Testing & Operational Excellence High attention to detail and discipline in service records, calibration logs, and repair documentation. Ability to work independently or as part of a team, executing assigned tasks reliably against schedule and procedures. Contributes to root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement based on test and field results. Ability to balance speed and rigor in fast‑moving, technically challenging environments. Professional Mindset & Working Style Hands‑on, practical mindset with a strong bias toward action and problem solving. Comfortable on the shop floor, in the lab, and at field locations as required, including travel. Strong safety and quality focus, with respect for procedures while helping refine them as systems and processes mature. Adaptable and resilient in early‑stage and transitioning‑to‑commercial technology environments. Open to giving and receiving constructive feedback that improves equipment performance and reliability. Nice to have Associate degree or higher in mechanical technology, mechatronics, or a related discipline. Experience with downhole tools, drillstring components, or other oilfield mechanical equipment. Familiarity with calibration management systems and qualification testing standards. Interest in geothermal energy, drilling systems, or high‑temperature downhole environments. What we offer: Opportunity to develop unique and innovative technological solutions which have the potential to change the world. title: Access Management Cluster Manager
description: Access Management Cluster Manager Department: Tournament and Venue Operations Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team. THE POSITION Reporting to the Access Management Senior Manager, you will be a key member of the FIFA WOMEN’S WORLD CUP 2027 Access Management team. You will be responsible for developing and implementing the Access Management operations for all the official venues across the tournament within Brazil, in line with Access Management policies and procedures. Through close coordination with other Functional Area (FA) and venue managers, you will ensure that the operations relating to the key movements of persons holding a FIFA access device into and within their official venues meets the requirements and provide efficient, safe, and well‑planned ingress, circulation & egress. The Access Management Cluster Manager will assist the Access Management Senior Manager by supporting the Access Management Venue Managers in the preparation stages of the tournament with the possibility of then assuming the position of Access Management Venue Manager of the Rio de Janeiro Stadium during the tournament. You will ensure security personnel and other responsible staff are provided with the necessary information, training and tools to operate access control effectively at each required location. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Oversight, training and support to the Access Management Venue Managers across all official venues including Stadia, Broadcast Centre, Venue Specific Hotels, and Training Sites. Implementation and operation of Access Management policies and procedures for accredited individuals in line with the accreditation and safety and security concepts for the tournament, including access control point setup and entitlement resolution. Planning and mapping of key client group flows, vertical transportation and ingress points onto venue maps and communication of flows and ingress points to all client groups via the provision of access tours, maps and briefings. Ensuring all client group flows, paths of travel, entrances and exits planned for people with disabilities and/or limited mobility meet FIFA and related local Accessibility standards and requirements. Provision of key wayfinding information as required to FIFA Dressing & Signage to ensure wayfinding on site is correct and as per all client group flows. Ensure that all wayfinding meets FIFA Accessibility standards and requirements. Facilitate additional and exceptional access requirements on site and assist all client groups with any access related issues. Ensuring all Functional Areas (FAs) at the venues can locate their working areas and know how to reach them, within the constraints of privilege zoning and restrictions. Ensuring all access staff and volunteers are trained and fully understand their roles and function and can perform the duties expected of them. YOUR PROFILE Education: Bachelor’s degree or similar level of higher education in IT & Systems, Sport Venue Management, Safety and Security or similar. If experience is compensating, lower degree is welcome to apply. Football access management knowledge. FIFA access management knowledge is a plus. Effective interpersonal communication, influencing and negotiation skills. Strong problem solving and analytical skills. Stature and professional experience necessary to interact as tough partner with senior colleagues. Good judgement, superb integrity, maturity, and fairness in dealing with people. Experience: Minimum experience of 2 years in the sport event industry, preferably within access management, accreditation, safety and security or venue management. Experience within FIFA is an advantage. Operation and setup of complex access control systems within ticketing and/or accreditation. Wayfinding and route planning in a stadium environment. Single-sport, multi-venue event experience. Management and leadership of a team in high pressure tournament operations. Demonstratable ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and under pressure. Requirements: Fluent in Portuguese and English. Right to work in Brazil. Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Engenheiro Cloud - Infraestrutura de Desenvolvimento
description: Engenheiro Cloud - Infraestrutura de Desenvolvimento Curte tecnologia, inovação e tem agilidade no DNA? Então talvez você tenha acabado de encontrar o seu próximo desafio! title: Profissional Program Planning
description: A primeira coisa que você precisa saber é que aqui você não vai cair na rotina. A Radix desenvolve soluções para empresas de diferentes setores e indústrias. Cada projeto tem suas tecnologias, soluções e prazos e você terá oportunidade de atuar e experimentar diferentes desafios. Quer fazer parte dessa história e transformar ideias e sonhos em realidade? Estabelecer uma rotina consistente de reportes, incluindo reuniões semanais, quinzenais ou mensais, conforme necessário. Preparar consolidações e resumos do programa para a liderança e executivos. Garantir que os dados dos projetos sejam precisos, atualizados e acionáveis. Manter visibilidade sobre o desempenho financeiro do programa, incluindo orçamento, realizado, forecast, margem, burn rate e alocação de custos. Consolidar informações financeiras de múltiplos projetos em uma visão única do programa. Identificar lacunas relacionadas ao acompanhamento orçamentário, alocação de recursos, utilização de centros de custo, change orders e previsões financeiras. Sinalizar inconsistências para os gerentes de projeto e para a liderança do programa, permitindo ações corretivas. Apoiar os gerentes de projeto com recomendações quando houver desvios financeiros ou de entrega. Monitorar áreas compartilhadas entre projetos, incluindo recursos comuns, dependências cruzadas e custos não atribuídos. Gestão de Performance da Execução e Riscos Monitorar cronogramas, custos, mudanças de escopo, riscos, problemas, dependências e saúde das entregas em todo o programa. Conduzir reuniões recorrentes de revisão com os gerentes de projeto. Questionar reportes incompletos, pouco claros ou quando o desempenho estiver abaixo do esperado. Identificar riscos antecipadamente e escalá-los com recomendações objetivas. Apoiar a elaboração de planos de ação corretiva para projetos atrasados, acima do orçamento, com falta de recursos ou sem responsáveis claramente definidos. Garantir que riscos, problemas e mudanças contratuais sejam identificados com antecedência suficiente para que a liderança possa atuar. Planejamento de Recursos e Capacidade Apoiar o planejamento de recursos e previsões de capacidade do programa. Monitorar se os recursos estão corretamente alocados aos projetos e centros de custo. Identificar situações de subalocação, sobrealocação e lacunas entre demanda e capacidade disponível. Apoiar a liderança na previsão de necessidades futuras de contratação com base no pipeline de projetos e compromissos de entrega. Ferramentas, Automação e Dados Utilizar ferramentas como Power BI, Pipedrive, Excel e outras plataformas de automação e reporte para aumentar a visibilidade e reduzir esforços manuais. Criar ou aprimorar dashboards que forneçam visibilidade em tempo real ou próxima do tempo real sobre o desempenho dos projetos e do programa. Promover melhorias contínuas nos processos de reporte, templates e qualidade dos dados. Trabalhar em parceria com gerentes de projeto, equipe financeira e liderança para tornar os dados do programa mais confiáveis e úteis para tomada de decisão. Para essa vaga, você deve ter: Experiência em suporte à gestão de projetos, gestão de programas, PMO, controle de projetos ou operações. Sólido entendimento de indicadores financeiros de projetos, incluindo orçamento, realizado, forecast, burn rate, margem e change orders. Capacidade de consolidar informações de múltiplos projetos e identificar tendências, riscos e oportunidades de melhoria. Forte experiência com Power BI, Excel e ferramentas de reporting/dashboard. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e conforto para questionar informações incompletas ou inconsistentes. Capacidade de atuar em um ambiente em crescimento e dinâmico, onde processos ainda estão sendo estruturados e aprimorados. description: Atuar com as rotinas de farmácia hospitalar, recebendo, armazenando, separando e dispensando medicamentos e materiais, sob a supervisão direta do Farmacêutico. Sobre o Hospital Pedro II - CER Santa Cruz Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II . A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade. Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia. Responsabilidades e atribuições Receber, conferir e armazenar os medicamentos e insumos; Controlar o estoque, distribuir, dispensar e fracionar medicamentos; Realizar a conferência da dispensação de medicamentos e insumos, sob supervisão direta do Farmacêutico; Realizar o controle de temperatura do ambiente e geladeira; Confeccionar etiquetas para unitarização de doses de medicamentos; Separar medicamentos por paciente e/ou setores; Controlar os medicamentos devolvidos; Auxiliar na limpeza e organização do setor; Realizar todas as atividades pertinentes ao cargo, sob supervisão direta do Farmacêutico; Realizar atividades de área/ setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor Imediato e padronizações da Instituição. Requisitos e qualificações Ensino médio completo; Curso Técnico em Farmácia completo; Experiência mínima de 06 meses como Técnico de Farmácia ou Auxiliar de Farmácia. Informações adicionais Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção. title: Facility Engineer
description: Job Family: Operations and Technical Management Location: Santos, BR, Rio de Janeiro, BR, Purpose As a Facility Engineer, you are responsible for monitoring and ensuring the production of the units, with a focus on the monitoring of all topside equipment. This role also includes troubleshooting and conducting incident analysis for any issues that arise in the units. Additionally, you ensure that all processes and facilities adhere to company and industry standards, safety regulations, and environmental guidelines, while optimizing performance, reliability, and cost‑effectiveness. Responsibilities Ensure that the unit operates within design conditions, maintaining optimal performance and safety. Ensure all facilities and processes adhere to industry safety standards, environmental regulations, and company policies. Conduct regular safety audits, hazard assessments, and risk analyses, implementing corrective actions as needed to mitigate risks. Conduct and participate actively in investigations of incidents related to production loss and process safety, ensuring thorough analysis and follow‑up actions. Oversee the day‑to‑day operation of production facilities, ensuring optimal performance and reliability. Implement and maintain best practices in process management, maintenance, and operational procedures to minimize downtime and reduce operational costs. Provide technical support to offshore operations, including process monitoring using tools like PI, SEEQ, and daily reports. Lead and coordinate facility‑related projects from conceptualization to execution, ensuring timely delivery within budget. Assist in planning, organizing, and coordinating planned interventions in process equipment such as CO2 membranes, SRP membranes, mol sieves, and guard filters. Provide technical recommendations to offshore teams for process optimization, improvements, and best practices. Conduct technical meetings with offshore teams to address process deviations and implement coordinated actions. Participate in and support risk assessments (HAZOP, HAZID, ORA, TRA, SIL) and review action plans. Execute technical internal audits offshore and support audits such as SGSO, ANP, CONAMA, and PAG. Share lessons learned and disseminate technical best practices across the organization. Support offshore teams in ramp‑up/down planning and equipment preservation for shutdowns (SD). Define and execute a 3‑Year Plan (3YP) related to preventive facilities scope, supporting the P &F Lead and Technical Specialists in the 3YP budget exercise. Education Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline. Experience Chemical industry acting as process or production engineer. Project business focussed in process engineering. Oil and gas experience (desired). Experience in industry. Functional Competencies Process – Process System Engineering Integrity and Reliability Remote Surveillance and Monitoring – Learning from events Reliability, Operability and Safety – Incident Management Process – Process Equipment and Internals Design Troubleshooting – ICSS Process Control – Analysis and Planning Equal Employment Opportunity SBM Offshore is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and affirmative action employer. SBM Offshore does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non‑disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Service Engineer (Rio de Janeiro)
description: Our ideal candidate independently performs installation and commissioning work; coordinates the work activities with other stakeholders at the customer site along with the Service Coordination and Scheduling team. You will contribute to Americas Operations Teams by delivering top level service on time and with our First Time Right processes. The role sits within Deepsea Operations team and reports to the Team Lead of Technical Services. Who we are Radio Holland is dedicated to pushing the boundaries of maritime technology, offering solutions that enhance the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of global shipping. As the first choice for NavCom solutions, we are committed to delivering reliable, cutting-edge navigation and communication technologies that empower vessels worldwide. With a focus on innovation and quality, Radio Holland continues to lead the industry in developing next-generation navigation systems and integrated bridge solutions, supporting maritime professionals in their mission to achieve safe and seamless operations at sea. Workplace type: Onsite with extensive travel Job Type: Full Time Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil What You Will Do You will: Perform installation and commissioning works on yards, ships and other maritime installations Install and commission maritime navigation, communication and automation equipment based on designs and technical drawings Ensure optimal work preparation to verify that all necessary information on work and scope is available before commencement of work Ensure that all required materials and tools are both present and ready for use, and manage the materials required in the execution of the project work Ensure that the work performed is within the agreed contract scope; ensure that all agreed conditions are met before the work starts. Report deviations to the project manager Ensure that all works can be executed in a safe and responsible manner; stop all works if not the case What Does Success Look Like? Success in the Service Engineer role is a result of compliance to procedures and repeatable successful delivery of service. Over the first 6 months, the Team Lead of Technical Services ensures you have the mentorship, training and certifications to have a long successful career in this industry. Radio Holland stands apart from the other service providers as uniquely skilled in various manufacturers products and services, and your position on this team allows professional skillsets to be grown to support the Americas Operations. Deliver Results A person is successful in this role when they: Check and test the operation of the delivered equipment based on the specified quality and functional requirements in the (technical) order and project data, drawings, inspection plans, scripts and test protocols Develop the skills to correct abnormalities and malfunctions across multiple OEMs and product lines Hand over the commissioned equipment to the client, record the customers approval and possible comments Record as-built changes in the documentation package, hand-over documents and warranty certificates Report on hours spent, progress, issues, deviations in work or scope, and safety concerns to the project manager and engineer to ensure accurate invoicing and documented trail of compliance Give user training on the delivered equipment. (when part of scope) Values and Behaviours Trust to act You take ownership, make informed decisions and follow through on commitments. Passionate to perform You bring energy, aim for high standards and look for ways to improve how work gets done. Make it fun You contribute to a positive working environment, build constructive relationships and collaborate with others in a way that creates energy. Act responsibly You make fair, ethical and sustainable choices, consider the impact of your actions and contribute to an inclusive and respectful workplace. What You Bring Willingness to grow and adapt to the ever changing workplace is essential to our success. Working as a team player, first and the mentee but soon as a mentor for your certifications onto your peers. Required Valid Driver’s License Electrical Experience Strong organizational and communication skills with English Fluency Preferred Obtained a Federal Communications Commission (FCC) or General Operator Certificate (GOC) licensing Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience in Engineering or relevant technical degree CAD experience #J-18808-Ljbffr

Vivência prática com o ecossistema de mídia digital (Google Ads, Meta Ads, DV360, Retail Media), com domínio suficiente para navegar nas plataformas, conferir configurações e orientar a equipe com autonomia. title: Subsea Engineer
description: Purpose To ensure that the offshore subsea equipment spread is operated and maintained in an efficient, organised, and controlled manner in accordance with manufacturer operating manuals and project procedures. Duties & Responsibilities The Subsea Engineer shall: Uphold project safety and environmental policies and ensure defects, incidents, near misses, and non-conformances are reported and investigated in line with applicable procedures. Ensure that subsea personnel and technicians work in accordance with safe systems of work, including risk assessments and control measures prior to task execution. Support supervision and coordination of subsea department personnel, maintaining discipline and compliance with applicable maritime codes of conduct. Participate in vessel emergency response duties and drills as per the Muster List. Assist with inspection, testing, and basic maintenance of vessel safety systems, including fire detection and alarm systems where required. Take responsibility for safe and efficient operation of subsea systems when acting in a supervisory capacity or in the absence of the senior subsea lead. Demonstrate full understanding of senior subsea engineer responsibilities, including launch and recovery of subsea assets and operational decision-making offshore. Ensure subsea systems are operated within approved operational and insurance limitations. Manage subsea systems during maintenance, refurbishment, or standby periods. Coordinate subsea team activities including work allocation and watchkeeping in supervisory scenarios. Support planning and execution of maintenance, repair, and overhaul of subsea equipment to ensure operational readiness at all times. Escalate system downtime or reduced functionality to vessel leadership and onshore management where required. Assist with reporting, documentation, and technical returns for subsea systems. Maintain awareness of operational factors including vessel manoeuvrability, weather conditions, currents, and seabed characteristics. Support training and development of junior technicians and subsea personnel. Undertake additional duties within the subsea engineering discipline as required by vessel or project management. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Je werkt op ons kantoor in Amsterdam, verdeeld over twee open verdiepingen met uitzicht op de Johan Cruijff ArenA en de Ziggo Dome. Een inspirerende plek waar je samenwerkt met collega’s uit alle disciplines aan slimme oplossingen voor onze klanten. Wat bieden wij jou? Jouw carrière. Jouw keuze. Salaris van € 18,29 per uur, inclusief vakantietoeslag; Begeleiding door een Development Manager waar je altijd terecht kunt. Grant Thornton is een netwerkorganisatie van wereldniveau. Internationaal zijn we één van de grootste accountants- en adviesorganisaties, een zevende plek wereldwijd! Hier in Nederland hebben we de fantastische voordelen van een kleinere organisatie met open cultuur, met de internationale mogelijkheden en multiculturele ervaring van één van de grootste organisaties ter wereld. Wij gaan altijd een stapje verder. Voor onze klanten en vooral ook voor jou. Zodat jij de allerbeste werkomgeving hebt, die inclusief is en waar we flink bezig zijn met duurzaamheid. We werken voor profit- én non-profitorganisaties. Specialiseer je zoals jij wilt en werk zo iedere dag aan een wereld die past bij jouw idealen en doelen. Solliciteer vandaag nog en ontdek hoe jij kunt groeien én bijdragen bij Grant Thornton! Meer weten over deze rol of werken bij Grant Thornton? title: Access Management Cluster Manager
description: Department: Tournament and Venue Operations Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team. The Position Reporting to the Access Management Senior Manager, you will be a key member of the FIFA WOMEN’S WORLD CUP 2027 Access Management team. You will be responsible for developing and implementing the Access Management operations for all the official venues across the tournament within Brazil, in line with Access Management policies and procedures. Through close coordination with other Functional Area (FA) and venue managers, you will ensure that the operations relating to the key movements of persons holding a FIFA access device into and within their official venues meets the requirements and provide efficient, safe, and well-planned ingress, circulation & egress. The Access Management Cluster Manager will assist the Access Management Senior Manager by supporting the Access Management Venue Managers in the preparation stages of the tournament with the possibility of then assuming the position of Access Management Venue Manager of the Rio de Janeiro Stadium during the tournament. You will ensure security personnel and other responsible staff are provided with the necessary information, training and tools to operate access control effectively at each required location. Key Responsibilities Oversight, training and support to the Access Management Venue Managers across all official venues including Stadia, Broadcast Centre, Venue Specific Hotels, and Training Sites. Implementation and operation of Access Management policies and procedures for accredited individuals in line with the accreditation and safety and security concepts for the tournament, including access control point setup and entitlement resolution. Planning and mapping of key client group flows, vertical transportation and ingress points onto venue maps and communication of flows and ingress points to all client groups via the provision of access tours, maps and briefings. Ensuring all client group flows, paths of travel, entrances and exits planned for people with disabilities and/or limited mobility meet FIFA and related local Accessibility standards and requirements. Provision of key wayfinding information as required to FIFA Dressing & Signage to ensure wayfinding on site is correct and as per all client group flows. Ensure that all wayfinding meets FIFA Accessibility standards and requirements. Facilitate additional and exceptional access requirements onsite and assist all client groups with any access related issues. Ensuring all Functional Areas (FAs) at the venues can locate their working areas and know how to reach them, within the constraints of privilege zoning and restrictions. Ensuring all access staff and volunteers are trained and fully understand their roles and function and can perform the duties expected of them. Your Profile Education Bachelor’s degree or similar level of higher education in IT & Systems, Sport Venue Management, Safety and Security or similar. If experience is compensating, lower degree is welcome to apply. Football access management knowledge. FIFA access management knowledge is a plus. Effective interpersonal communication, influencing and negotiation skills. Strong problem solving and analytical skills. Stature and professional experience necessary to interact as tough partner with senior colleagues. Good judgement, superb integrity, maturity, and fairness in dealing with people. Experience Experience with the sport event industry, preferably within access management, accreditation, safety and security or venue management. Experience within FIFA is an advantage. Operation and setup of complex access control systems within ticketing and/or accreditation. Wayfinding and route planning in a stadium environment. Single-sport, multi-venue event experience. Management and leadership of a team in high pressure tournament operations. Demonstratable ability to manage multiple projects concurrently and under pressure. Requirements Fluent in Portuguese and English. Right to work in Brazil. Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description: Senior Machine Learning Engineer – Teya Senior Machine Learning Engineer you will build models and decision systems that turn Teya's data into better outcomes for our customers and our business. You will work in the AI Research & Development team partnering with engineers, product managers, and domain experts to take problems from framing through model development and into reliable, monitored production systems. Responsibilities Frame ambiguous business problems as well-posed modeling, inference, or optimization tasks, and choose methods that fit the data and the decision. Design, build, validate, and deploy predictive and decisioning models across areas such as fraud and risk monitoring, customer onboarding and due diligence, pricing, and customer lifetime value. Run rigorous experiments and causal analyses, including A/B testing, uplift modeling, and offline evaluation, to measure whether models actually move the outcomes that matter. Engineer features and build the data pipelines that feed training and serving, with attention to leakage, reproducibility, and data quality. Productionise models with strong attention to validation, backtesting, monitoring, drift detection, and retraining, so performance holds up after launch. Work closely with product managers, engineers, and domain experts to identify where modeling creates value and to integrate models into products and operational workflows. Apply optimization and operations research methods where decisions, not just predictions, are the goal. Contribute to modeling standards, evaluation practices, and reusable tooling across the team. Stay current with developments in machine learning and statistics, and apply new methods where they earn their place. Requirements Strong foundations in statistics and machine learning, with the judgment to match methods to problems. Proficiency in Python and its data and ML ecosystem (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn, NumPy), and strong SQL. Hands-on experience building and deploying machine learning models in production, not only in notebooks. Solid command of supervised and unsupervised learning, including methods such as gradient boosting, regularised regression, and clustering, with a clear understanding of model evaluation and overfitting. Experience with experimentation and inference, including A/B testing and the basics of causal estimation. Experience with cloud platforms and modern engineering practices (CI/CD, APIs, monitoring, infrastructure as code). Strong software engineering fundamentals including testing, reproducibility, and maintainability. Ability to communicate quantitative findings and their business implications clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Nice to have Experience building models in regulated industries such as payments, fintech, banking, risk, compliance, or fraud prevention. Experience with use cases such as: Fraud detection and anomaly detection Credit and onboarding risk decisioning Pricing and customer lifetime value modeling Churn and propensity modeling Forecasting and time series Recommendation and personalisation Background in operations research, mathematical programming, or stochastic optimization. Knowledge of MLOps, model lifecycle management, feature stores, monitoring, and governance. Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow where the problem warrants them. Familiarity with data engineering concepts, analytics platforms, and experimentation frameworks. Contributions to the ML or statistics community through open source, research, or technical writing. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or background can thrive and do their best work. If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know – we are committed to ensuring a fair and accessible experience. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Etapas do Processo Seletivo Triagem People Interview Hiring Manager Interview Live Case Stakeholder Interview Offer Sobre a Área O Marketplace do QuintoAndar está em forte expansão pelo Brasil, e o sucesso desse movimento depende diretamente de conquistar as imobiliárias certas em cada praça . Para isso, estamos contratando Executivos(as) de Expansão — Hunters — que vão ser responsáveis por liderar o fechamento de parcerias com imobiliárias em sua praça de atuação. Esta é uma posição de frente de batalha : você vai pegar uma praça, conhecê‑la melhor do que ninguém, mapear quem importa, abrir portas com as imobiliárias mais estratégicas e fechar contratos que se traduzem em crescimento real para o negócio. Perfil hunter de verdade: energia para abrir portas, resiliência para lidar com não e senso de urgência. Excelente comunicação e capacidade de argumentação , com facilidade para construir rapport com decisores sêniores e conduzir conversas com C-Level/donos de negócio. Habilidade de negociação consultiva , sabendo navegar objeções complexas, construir propostas ganha-ganha e fechar com disciplina comercial. Forte capacidade de mapeamento e leitura de mercado , identificando perfis com potencial de influência, engajamento e impacto na praça. Autonomia, organização e senso de dono. Domínio de CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pipedrive ou similar) e disciplina de pipeline/forecast. Disponibilidade para atuação em campo na praça sob sua responsabilidade. Diferenciais Vivência com imobiliárias, corretores de imóveis ou mercado imobiliário — ter rede e fluência no jargão do setor ajuda. Experiência em startups, scale-ups, proptechs ou marketplaces em fase de hipercrescimento. Familiaridade com metodologias estruturadas de venda. Conhecimento de funil de aquisição, testes de canal e experimentação comercial. Responsabilidades Ser dono(a) da praça sob sua responsabilidade: entender o mercado local, mapear as principais imobiliárias, identificar players de alta influência e priorizar contas com maior potencial de impacto. Liderar a prospecção ativa e o relacionamento com imobiliárias estratégicas, indo a campo quando necessário para construir confiança e destravar negócios. Conduzir todo o ciclo de venda consultiva: descoberta, demonstração de valor, construção de proposta, negociação de termos e fechamento do contrato de parceria. Bater (e superar) as metas individuais de fechamento de imobiliárias parceiras. Realizar abordagens consultivas com decisores (sócios, diretores, gestores), entendendo o contexto e as dores específicas de cada imobiliária e conectando‑as à proposta de valor do QuintoAndar. Trabalhar em conjunto com o time de BDRs no refinamento de pipeline, qualificação de oportunidades e priorização da carteira. Abrir portas em contas estratégicas onde a prospecção tradicional não basta — usando networking, eventos do setor, indicações e presença local como alavancas. Identificar e ativar perfis com potencial de influência, transformando parceiros em embaixadores e amplificadores na praça. Mapear continuamente o mercado da praça: clusters geográficos, perfis de imobiliária, movimentos da concorrência e oportunidades não óbvias. Construir relacionamento de longo prazo com decisores‑chave, mantendo proximidade mesmo após o fechamento para garantir engajamento e expansão da parceria. Testar novas estratégias de aquisição: canais, discursos, segmentações e formatos de oferta, capturando aprendizados que possam ser replicados em outras praças. Atuar como voz da praça internamente, trazendo insights de mercado para Produto, Marketing e Operações. Manter o pipeline rigorosamente atualizado no CRM, com forecast preciso e visibilidade clara da saúde dos deals. Acompanhar de perto seus indicadores de funil — taxa de conexão, conversão entre etapas, ciclo de venda, win rate, ticket médio — e usar esses números para ajustar a própria atuação. Contribuir para a construção de playbooks, pitches e melhores práticas que serão usados pelo time de Expansão como um todo. Colaborar com pares de outras praças, compartilhando aprendizados e elevando o nível do time. Importante O nosso processo seletivo começa na candidatura! Se você está realmente a fim de fazer parte do nosso time, foque nessa etapa do processo. Nós analisamos todos os candidatos individualmente e damos retorno para todas as pessoas que investiram tempo em se candidatar. Toda comunicação é feita por e-mail, então fique atento às nossas mensagens e libere o domínio @quintoandar.com.br para que nossos e-mails não sejam parar no spam. title: Senior Commercial Analyst, Gas and Power
description: ## Senior Commercial Analyst, Gas and PowerApplylocations: Rio De Janeiro, Braziltime type: Full timeposted on: Posted Todayjob requisition id: JR **Important!** To make sure your application is considered, please submit it before the end of the day on (dd.mm.yyyy): We encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.# What does the job involve?Strategy and Business Development is the business unit within Marketing, Midstream and Processing at Equinor which is accountable for business development activities in MMP across the full range of MMP existing and emerging/future commodities and products. For oil & gas development, acquisition, and divestment projects, SBD is accountable for coordinating all marketing and midstream deliverables, including commercial analysis, mid- and downstream architecture, MMP negotiated agreements, optimal commodity route to market, and value uplift. In Brazil, this unit has the responsibility to ensure flow assurance for equity gas, which includes originating gas and natural gas liquids sales transactions, negotiating access to infrastructure, and balancing and optimizing from production to market the Equinor domestic gas portfolio. By joining our team in Marketing, Midstream & Processing you will have the opportunity to: Be a key contributor to achieving the unit’s ambition of developing a Brazil market position to capture value and secure flow assurance of our upstream portfolio. The successful candidate will work across the business, and the position provides the opportunity to shape the direction of Equinor’s market position in Brazil. This position will contribute to the structuring, negotiation and execution of commercial transactions, and provide analytical insight to support business decisions, while also contributing to shaping Equinor’s market position in Brazil.# What will my tasks be?Within this position, your key tasks will be to:* Contribute to origination, structuring and execution of gas sales transactions and related agreements.* Contribute to negotiation of gas sales, infrastructure access and commercial contracts.* Develop pricing models and support financial and risk assessment of transactions.* Identify and analyze value drivers, risks and optionality in structured agreements.* Monitor regulatory developments and market trends in gas and power markets.* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders (trading, operations, legal, risk) to support deal execution.* Contribute to development of new commercial products and solutions.# Here's what we expect from you:At Equinor, there are some overall qualities we regard as essential. We want you to identify with the values that guide our decisions and help us succeed and grow: open, collaborative, courageous and caring. We expect you to make safety your priority and to contribute to our zero-harm culture. And for this specific position, we are also looking for:* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering, Business or equivalent.* 7+ years Relevant experience in Brazilian energy markets, preferably gas or power commercialization with experience in commercial analysis or business development / deal structuring roles.* Strong analytical, financial modelling and problem-solving skills preferably with a knowledge of relevant tools, programs and automation processes.* An interest and knowledge of AI tools and processes would be beneficial for future integration and projects.* Effective communication and stakeholder engagement.* Collaborative mindset with an ability to learn quickly and adapt to changing environments.* Fluency in Portuguese and English.# What can we offer you?We want you to have a rewarding and fulfilling work life. That’s why we offer:Not just a job - a careerIn Equinor, your development begins on day one. You will build your competence through a wide range of learning activities while being empowered to build your career across multiple disciplines and geographies. Our internal job market allows a wide range of opportunities for development and growth within your own field, or even in other areas you find interesting and relevant.Attractive rewardsWe give you a comprehensive benefits package with a competitive salary, global parental leave, bonus scheme and pension plan.Wellness and work-life balanceWe care about and prioritise our employees’ well-being. If you have any specific requirements, please clarify this in your application and our team will be in contact to see how we can support your needs. We also believe everyone should be paid fairly and consistently for their contribution to our collective success. To ensure fairness and transparency, positions at Equinor are evaluated using our global job architecture based on the position’s responsibilities, complexity, and impact, and regularly reviewed to ensure consistency and alignment across the organisation.# Important notes about the application processWe expect you to openly offer all relevant information about yourself during the recruitment process. When applying for a job in Norway you will be asked for information on affiliation to high-risk countries for a security assessment.# About EquinorEquinor is an international energy company headquartered in Norway, energising the lives of 170 million people worldwide. Our task is enormous: supplying the world with the energy it needs, while lowering emissions to the atmosphere. Esse profissional será responsável por executar e garantir a integridade das atividades de segurança cibernética em ambientes industriais (OT/IACS), trabalhando em estreita colaboração com a liderança técnica para mapear riscos, desenhar arquiteturas seguras e implementar melhorias de infraestrutura industrial. Interface e Alinhamento: Colaborar e garantir a interface técnica com os times de Engenharia, Operação, TI/Segurança Corporativa, fornecedores vendors e suporte ao time offshore. Melhoria Contínua: Apoiar o plano de remediação de vulnerabilidades e aplicar boas práticas de hardening em sistemas industriais. Formação Acadêmica: Graduação concluída em Engenharia (Automação, Elétrica, Computação ou correlatas), Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas de TI. Experiência Prática: Experiência em projetos ou sustentação de Cyber Security voltados para ambientes de Automação Industrial (OT / IACS). Conhecimentos em Normas e Modelos: Sólido entendimento da norma IEC 62443 e do Modelo Purdue (Arquiteturas Industriais). Redes e Infraestrutura: Conhecimento prático em redes industriais (Layer 2/3, VLANs, roteamento e regras de Firewalls). Habilidades Técnicas: Experiência com levantamento de ativos assessment, análise de vulnerabilidades industriais e aplicação de hardening. description: Senior Software Engineer (Github) - IC5 - 2026 About Us Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building. Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. About the team The GitHub Governance team is one of the highest‑leverage teams in ETS. It decides — and operationalizes — how ten thousand Nubankers interact with GitHub, how repositories are governed, how access is granted and revoked, how vulnerabilities are surfaced and triaged, and how the platform serves as the substrate for AI‑assisted development at Nubank. The team's mandate touches every engineer in the company and every InfoSec, IAM, and Datasec partner that depends on the platform. The team is currently four people, holding the platform's active mandate: KPMG audit obligations, EMU (Enterprise Managed Users) migration, rollouts including Copilot Code Review, vibe‑coding profile design, the inactivity‑rule mechanism, and IP control work tied to the AI‑First posture. Every GitHub change at Nubank now routes through formal change management with InfoSec. About the role This role is a senior individual contributor on the GitHub Governance team, sharing technical ownership of the platform's surface with the existing senior engineers. The role is hands-on and execution-heavy: shipping platform changes, building automation, partnering with InfoSec on IAM and Datasec design decisions, and contributing senior judgment to the team's most exposed work. The role operates with autonomy, owning problems end-to-end, making technical calls within its scope without waiting for direction, and knowing when to elevate versus move forward. What the person will own As a Senior Software Engineer you will work across the team's portfolio, owning the slices that fit their depth and partnering on the rest. The current portfolio includes KPMG audit response and evidence collection, EMU migration (user‑profile migration is the active Wave 1, with the Identity Hub workaround as the path forward), rollouts including Copilot Code Review, vibe‑coding profile work and the connected guardrails, the inactivity‑rule design, and IP control mechanisms. Beyond execution, you will be a senior voice in the team's design discussions: architecture decisions, integration patterns with Identity Hub, ITSec/IAM/Datasec touchpoints, and the cross‑pack discussions with Coding Tools, AI Enablement, and Enterprise Solutions. You will be one of the engineers shaping how GitHub‑change governance works in practice at Nubank. This role will also serve as a technical partner in shaping the team's GitHub platform strategy, working alongside the PM to evaluate GitHub's product roadmap, anticipate how upcoming features affect Nubank's governance model. What we are looking for Must-haves Demonstrated depth administering GitHub Enterprise at scale (10,000+ users), including EMU (Enterprise Managed Users), organization and repo‑level policy design, and rulesets. Hands‑on experience with GitHub Copilot administration and rollout at an organizational level. Proficiency with the GitHub API and automation via GitHub Actions, including building or maintaining CODEOWNERS structures and branch protection patterns at scale. Working knowledge of GitHub audit logs and the ability to trace a policy decision through to its downstream effects on users, repositories, audit trails, and connected systems. Prior experience operating within a regulated engineering organization, with working knowledge of how InfoSec, IAM, and Datasec functions interact with a platform engineering team. Track record of working cross‑functionally with security leadership, tooling/enablement teams, and engineering stakeholders — writing clearly, pushing back constructively, and building trust quickly across functions without formal authority over those teams. Nice‑to‑have Experience supporting or shaping an organization's AI‑adoption strategy as it intersects with developer tooling and platform policy (e.g., Copilot governance, AI‑assisted coding guardrails). Familiarity with running GitHub Enterprise in a multi‑business‑unit or multi‑pack organizational structure, including navigating competing stakeholder priorities. Experience partnering directly with external auditors (e.g., Big Four firms) on platform‑level compliance evidence or remediation. Chance of earning equity at Nubank. Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale‑Transporte). NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program. Life Insurance. Medical Plan. NuLanguage – Language Course Program. Nucleo – Our learning platform of courses. Benefits Benefits include equity, healthcare plans, transportation benefits, language courses, and our NuCare assistance programs. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Senior Process Safety Engineer
description: The Process Safety Engineer will be responsible for supporting process safety studies, risk assessments, and governance activities, ensuring compliance with statutory and corporate requirements. The role contributes to the management of safety barriers, risk mitigation measures, process safety programmes, and continuous improvement initiatives across operations. Responsibilities Plan and be accountable for the execution of regular technical safety studies and risk assessments Select consultancies and guide the execution of BWE procedures for safety studies and risk assessments Lead risk assessments using different techniques, with and without support from consultancies Support the management of the reliability and availability of Safety Critical Elements Guide the management of change related to process safety Conduct regular risk analyses across operational processes, identifying gaps and recommending corrective actions to address safety deficiencies. Collaborate with other team leads and disciplines to identify opportunities to improve processes for both safety and productivity. Contribute to the definition of process safety programme requirements and work with activity owners to ensure those requirements are effectively implemented. Support the implementation and maintenance of barriers identified across all major event scenarios, monitoring their effectiveness and escalating deviations. Keep up to date with Process Safety policy developments, legislative changes, and emerging best practices, sharing relevant insights with the team. Participate in the delivery of process safety governance and assurance activities, including audit preparation, data gathering, and action plan follow-up. Facilitate operational and major hazard risk assessments under the guidance of the Process Safety Lead, progressively taking ownership of assessments as experience grows. Develop and review standards and procedures in Process Safety, supporting their implementation to ensure Personal Safety risks are mitigated to a level that is As Low As Reasonably Practicable (ALARP), in compliance with all statutory and corporate requirements and aligned with industry best practices. Contribute to workforce process safety communications, including incident trend summaries, investigation findings, process safety bulletins, and lessons learned materials. Represent BWE at relevant industry forums and networking activities as appropriate, disseminating learnings to the workforce and participating in incident investigations as required. Support the achievement of safety KPIs. Requirements Education Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related areas. Postgraduate qualification in Process Safety, HSE Management, or a related discipline is desirable. Experience Experience in Process Safety within Oil & Gas or Petrochemical related industries, with solid experience in the operation, maintenance, and inspection of Upstream and Downstream oil and gas processing facilities. Technical knowledge across the main aspects of Process Safety Management. Good knowledge of Hazard and Risk Analysis methodologies, including HAZOP, HAZID, QRA, SIL assessments, LOPA, area classification, and dispersion analyses. Good knowledge of CCPS/IOSH Process Safety standards, applicable industry codes, regulations, and best practices. Good analytical skills with the ability to recognise trends, assess risks, and identify root causes. Ability to apply sound judgement in problem solving, evaluating courses of action, and making decisions on complex health and safety matters. Knowledge Advanced English Excellent report writing skills. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Develop and align specific RCM process focused on equipment function (not just design), enabling targeted identification and mitigation of functional failures. Develop, manage, update and monitor implementation of short and long-term asset management policy, strategy, initiatives and work plans for power system asset and ensure alignment with overall company Strategic Asset Management Program. Manage PS owned Substations by deploying Asset Integrity Management System (AIMS) Program. Manage Power Systems HV Electrical Equipment Life Cycle Managements Process. Develop and manage single point of failure assessment to sustain Power Supply in case of equipment failure. Evaluate risk-based maintenance methodology based on likelihood and consequences. Provide technical guidance and tools in the area of risk and reliability assessment and management to work groups involved with distribution infrastructure replacement, substation infrastructure replacement, and transmission infrastructure replacement. Perform Asset failure trending and analysis. Identify repetitive failures and perform RCA to avoid reoccurrence of failures. Perform data analysis using techniques (APM, RCA, Six Sigma (6σ) etc.). Calculate and update the asset KPI’s. Issue reliability program monthly reports (MTBF, MTTR, bad actors, etc) updating the equipment health progress, and reporting failures and successes. Oversees PS assets performance and report PS technical KPIs for T&D assets. Utilize SAP Failure Reporting Analysis and Corrective Action System (FRACAS) to document and track unreliability events and reliability improvements opportunities. Provide technical information for field unreliability events backed up with equipment history & process data intended for area maintenance. Review the PM Defect Reports and evaluate corrective actions. Participate in developing, revising and tracking Asset Management strategies. Supervise the documentation and development of asset inventory for each class of assets, asset condition, level of service and performance, risk signature, maintenance strategies, repair/replacement models, financial forecasts, and tactical and work plans. Have a minimum of 8 years of experience in Oil & Gas, Petrochemical Industry or Power utility in the field of Power Systems Reliability & Asset Integrity Management. Familiar with reliability programs such as (RAM, RCM, RMS, MTBF, Bad actors, etc.) including SAP system or equivalent computerized systems. title: Purchaser

Additionally, the professional will manage supplier relationships, oversee database maintenance, and handle logistics and contract close-outs. Leading a team of purchasers and driving continuous improvements in local supply chain practices are also key aspects of this position. Responsibilities Responsible for procurement of small to medium equipment packages, in accordance with Supply Chain (SC) related procedures; Ensure compliance with BW Energy’s Supply Chain (SC) related procedures and project specific Material Management (Procurement) plan; Responsible for the day to day procurement, expediting and control of the entire supply chain from requisition until delivery on-board for a group of units, in accordance with Supply Chain (SC) related procedure; Liaise with freight forwarders, client and logistics at country of operation when required to consolidate as many regular orders as possible and keep the number of deliveries and cost of freight and custom handling to a minimum; Assure quality, suitability of spares and equipment purchased, in close liaison with adequate departments/division; Actively follow-up changes in the supplier marked and keep a good and balanced contact with domestic as well as international associates, take active part in supplier meetings; Apply thorough cost control on all goods quoted, purchased and supplied under his/her responsibility; Actively contribute to implementation of and understanding of frame agreements, as well as being able to see where additional agreements are required; Enforce offshore unit management to follow Company's policies and Procedures in SC matters; Actively contribute to global SC in bid input related to new contracts in the local market; Liaison with global SC to ensure optimal sourcing for the offshore unit(s); Oversee that group of units IFS database are maintained and updated at all time, and on quarter basis liaise with requisitioner (FPSO) over non attended purchase requisition and verify if material is still required or not; Participate in daily/weekly Operations meetings with the Unit, Maintenance and Operation Manager; Provide regular status and progress reporting (Procurement Status Report (PSR), etc.); Maintain relevant knowledge of various commodities, available manufacturers and sources; Sourcing and development of Bidders List; Prepare and issue Requests for Quotations (RFQs); Evaluate quotations, carry out bid clarifications, condition bids and negotiate with suppliers; Review supplier’s qualifications on Terms and Conditions and coordination with in house Legal team on the review of such qualifications; Perform Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) / Life Cycle Costs (LCC) analysis; Prepare recommendation for award;Prepare and issue Purchase Orders in IFS; Verify supplier’s production schedule, ensuring the supplier has a complete and capable plan for meeting the delivery requirements, and work closely with Expeditors on relevant packages; Identify potential and actual disruptions in the supplier’s submission and delivery schedules, propose mitigating measures and work closely with supplier to remedy situation; Certification of progress or milestone payments; Complete supplier performance evaluation and coordinate input from other department /disciplines; Finalization of account; Manage contract close out, document retention/archive activities; Supervise and lead a group of Project Purchasers where necessary; Perform other procurement discipline tasks as required, such as expediting, logistics coordination and material receiving; Taking ownership and active part in implementation of SC initiatives, ensure compliance of best practices and procurement procedures; Actively contribute to continuous improvements of best practices and lessons learned;Liaise with other internal stakeholders (Finance, Legal, Business Development, Estimating, Engineering, etc.) Work in conjunction with the company's global legal department in negotiating contracts to supply items or services. Guarantee that all services, contracts required for oil lifting operations are implemented as required; Work with finance department, tax department and others department to ensure the company is adequately handling the tax suspension regime (if applicable); Ensure that the function complies with all E&P policies, procedures and internal compliance requirements; Actively pursue the development and implementation of local supply chain practices in alignment with global best practices and procedures to meet the company's strategic objectives; Comply with local content regulations and optimize package delivery. Work closely with the SC Manager to ensure negotiation of engagement and implementation of strategic contracts with suppliers, be they short, long or MSA contracts to ensure full compliance; Obtain market knowledge from local and global suppliers and maintain supplier relationships when necessary; Education Degree within Purchasing and/or Logistic Administration will be preferred; Long relevant experience may replace educational requirements. Experience Relevant experience in the role; Previous experience with ERP systems; Knowledge In depth knowledge of the local supply market for the oil & gas industry and general knowledge to the international oil & gas supplier market; Familiar with the terminology of the oil & gas industry; Technical knowledge/understanding of the oil & gas industry is an advantage; Advanced in English (oral and written); Understanding and knowledge of the technical, contractual and commercial issues related to design and engineering of Floating, Production, Storage and Offloading vessels is an advantage. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Senior FSRU Operations Engineer
description: Founded in 1948, Karadeniz Holding is a visionary industry leader that focuses on innovation while supporting growth with an emphasis on economic and environmental sustainability across a wide range of industries, primarily energy and shipbuilding. Operating in more than 20 countries, with over 3,000 employees from 30 different nationalities and an installed capacity exceeding 8,000 MW, the Group generates reliable and clean electricity across four continents through its fleet of 45 Powership™ and 11 LNG vessels, providing employment to more than 10,000 people worldwide. Karadeniz Holding manages its Powership™ fleet under its international brand Karpowership, meeting between 10% and 100% of the electricity needs of the countries where it operates across Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Asia. With high-capacity energy solutions, including Powership™, land-based plants, and floating LNG infrastructure, Karpowership supports countries and companies in their energy transition processes. We are looking for an Senior FSRU Operations Engineer to join our operations in Brazil, based at our Rio de Janeiro office. WHAT DO WE EXPECT? Candidates combining an engineering degree with seagoing FSRU/LNG tanker experience will be prioritized. >8Years (minimum 4 years directly in FSRU or LNG terminal operations) Advanced English (mandatory) | Portuguese — working proficiency minimum (mandatory). MS Office (advanced); SAP PM/MM; MS Project (desirable); Power BI (desirable)STCW Basic Safety Training (desirable); GWO (desirable); OPITO LNG or SIGTTO gas industry certification will be a strong plus. Strong analytical and report‑writing skills in English and Portuguese. Proven ability to manage interfaces with multiple stakeholders (regulatory authorities, charterers, OEMs, Class societies). Ability to interpret and operationalize BBC/OSA contractual clauses. Experience with Brazilian energy/maritime regulators (ANP, ANTAQ, Brazilian Navy) strongly preferred. Willingness to travel to vessel/terminal sites as required. WHAT AWAITS YOU? Support with local needs for the new FSRUs readiness programme ahead of first gas‑out, following commissioning activities between the vessel crew, engineering teams, and client/offtaker representatives. Develop and manage the Pre‑Operations Checklist, punch lists, and start‑up procedures in alignment with BBC and OSA contract conditions. Oversee preparation and submission of all documentation required by ANP, ANTAQ, and Brazilian Navy prior to FSRU commercial operations commencement. Support preparation for mooring, berthing, and jetty/buoy interface assessments and ensure FSRU is ready to meet contractual operational start date (COD). Track and report pre‑operations milestones, flagging risks to Senior Leadership in a timely manner. Serve as the onshore focal point for daily FSRU operational activities, maintaining continuous interface with the vessel’s Senior Officers (Master, Chief Engineer, Gas Officer) and onshore management. Monitor send‑out rates, regasification performance, boil‑off gas (BOG) management, and LNG inventory, ensuring alignment with contracted dispatch schedules and offtaker requirements. Supervise planned and unplanned maintenance activities, ensuring operational continuity is preserved and any downtime is managed within BBC/OSA contractual allowances. Supervise LNG cargo receiving operations, including Ship‑to‑Ship (STS) transfers: pre‑transfer planning, compatibility assessments, authority approvals (ANP Authorization, ANTAQ), and post‑transfer reporting. Ensure continuous compliance with ANP Resolution 810/2020 (Safety Management for LNG terminals/FSRUs), ANP Resolution 982/2022 (gas quality standards), and all applicable ANP authorization conditions for FSRU operations. Support and follow‑up all ANTAQ requirements are met for the FSRU as a port facility and maritime installation, including ISPS compliance, operational safety, and berthing/mooring approvals. WHAT DO WE OFFER? Hybrid working model One day off on your birthday Private health insurance (extended to dependents) and life insurance Variable compensation package and performance‑based bonus Meal allowance + food allowance in line with market practices Mobility benefits (transport allowance and parking policy) Well‑being and quality of life programs, including TotalPass Professional and personal training and development opportunities Multicultural environment with exposure to international projects Opportunity to contribute to strategic energy transition projects In line with our “One World” philosophy, we are adding success to our achievements with our colleagues, candidates, and all stakeholders. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all applicants, regardless of race, religion, language or gender and we crown our success with our diversity.
